name: release-cli
description: Release workflow for the ytstats npm CLI. Gated on a clean tree, green tests, and a recorded changelog. Bumps, stamps CHANGELOG.md, commits, and tags. Has an unreleased ledger mode. Never publishes.

git.description: Git version control - used for status, log, diff, commit, and tag

node.description: Node.js runtime - used to read the version from package.json

npm.description: npm CLI - used to run the test suite as a release gate. Bundled with Node.js

install.darwin: Bundled with Node.js: brew install node
install.linux: Bundled with Node.js. Use nvm: https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm
install.win32: Bundled with Node.js: winget install OpenJS.NodeJS
